newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ARAGONES GETS UNEXPECTED SUPPORT FROM VALENCIA CHAIRMAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARAGONES GETS UNEXPECTED SUPPORT FROM VALENCIA CHAIRMAN.

text.p: Valencia coach Luis Aragones has been unexpectedly thrown a line by chairman Paco Roig after another turbulent week at the club.
"I won't fire Aragones," said Roig after a board meeting held to discuss the problems at the club on Thursday.
The relationship between Roig and Aragones has been strained since Valencia signed Brazilian striker Romario against the coach's wishes.
Romario has returned to the starting line-up after being dropped at the beginning of the season, but missed a penalty in Wednesday's 1-0 home defeat by unfancied Logrones.

Before the game Aragones had said that Valencia were not as good as the five or six best teams in the country, adding to media speculation in Spain that Aragones is trying to create a situation in which the club are obliged to fire him.
Last year's runners-up, Valencia are currently languishing mid-table in the Spanish league. By contrast their only European encounter was a shock UEFA Cup victory over holders Bayern Munich.
